🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-11 23:00 → 2026-09-12 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Semantic ABI submitted** — A new protocol artifact cleared the development stage and reached the submission milestone, opening the path to group review. [tg:tawg:4632]

> **Clean-room onboarding completed end-to-end** — A structured multi-person relay carried an exposure check, access invite, and frozen pack confirmation through to a new collaborator's confirmed acceptance. [tg:tawg:4639]

> **Byte-change concern flagged before interoperability deposit** — A potential inconsistency in signed bytes was caught ahead of the deposit, giving the team time to reconcile cleanly. [issue #39, pre-deposit comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/issues/39#issuecomment-5642981437)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### semantic-abi

_A new protocol artifact reached the submission milestone today._

- Merlini (@gobross) submitted the Semantic ABI, moving a new protocol artifact from active development to the submission stage and making it available for group review and iteration. [tg:tawg:4632]

### clean-room access

_The onboarding coordination for a new clean-room participant moved from initial setup to confirmed access today._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) structured a prior-exposure check for a new collaborator against a restricted repository, establishing the integrity baseline required before access to the derivation pack could be granted. [tg:tawg:4625]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) collected and relayed the new collaborator's self-reported prior-exposure answers, providing the confirmed clean-room baseline that allowed the access process to advance. [tg:tawg:4630]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) sent the clean-room repo invite once the exposure check cleared, completing the controlled access-grant step and opening the frozen-pack derivation phase for the new collaborator. [tg:tawg:4636]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) relayed the invite details, frozen pack commit reference, and hash-recording instructions to the new collaborator, ensuring all integrity constraints were conveyed before any restricted material was revealed. [tg:tawg:4638]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) confirmed that the new collaborator accepted the invite and that the frozen pack with hash-pinned derivation sequence remains intact, completing the full onboarding relay. [tg:tawg:4639]

### recompute-kit

_The interoperability report staging reached a quality checkpoint before the deposit step._

- Certisyn flagged a byte-change concern on the interoperability report before the deposit, giving the team a critical window to reconcile signed bytes and avoid a post-deposit integrity conflict. [issue #39, pre-deposit comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/issues/39#issuecomment-5642981437)

- Baby Blue Viper acknowledged the pre-deposit flag and confirmed the team understood the concern, keeping the interoperability report staging process on track for a clean deposit. [issue #39, acknowledgement](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/issues/39#issuecomment-5646634114)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the Semantic ABI submission opens a formal review window and what feedback the group wants to gather before it advances further
- How the flagged byte-change issue on the interoperability report will be resolved and whether re-signing is needed before the deposit

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review the Semantic ABI submission and share feedback so the iteration cycle can continue
- Resolve the byte-change discrepancy on the interoperability report before the deposit proceeds

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A clean-room onboarding sequence ran from initial exposure check all the way to confirmed invite acceptance through a tightly coordinated relay — each handoff logged and integrity-verified before the next step could begin.
>
> When a whole team operates like a hash-verified relay race, even the most careful access controls move at the speed of trust 🚀
